import pytest
from calendar_core.slots import Event, free_slots, overlaps, parse_time, fmt_duration


def test_issue_unsorted_disjoint():
    """Events may arrive in any order and may overlap each other."""
    result = free_slots([Event(720, 780), Event(540, 600)], 480, 1020)
    expected = [(480, 540), (600, 720), (780, 1020)]  # 480=8*60, 540=9*60, 600=10*60, 720=12*60, 780=13*60, 1020=17*60
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_nested_overlap():
    """Events may arrive in any order and may overlap each other."""
    result = free_slots([Event(540, 700), Event(600, 650)], 480, 800)
    expected = [(480, 540), (700, 800)]  # 480=8*60, 540=9*60, 700=11*60+40, 800=13*60+20
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_chain_overlap_merges():
    """Events may arrive in any order and may overlap each other."""
    result = free_slots([Event(650, 700), Event(540, 610), Event(600, 660)], 480, 800)
    expected = [(480, 540), (700, 800)]  # 480=8*60, 540=9*60, 700=11*60+40, 800=13*60+20; busy merges to 540-700
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_clip_starts_before_day():
    """Events partly outside the day are clipped to it."""
    result = free_slots([Event(400, 550)], 480, 1020)
    expected = [(550, 1020)]  # 550=9*60+10, 1020=17*60; clipped busy is 480-550 so gap 1020-550=470
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_clip_ends_after_day():
    """Events partly outside the day are clipped to it."""
    result = free_slots([Event(950, 1100)], 480, 1020)
    expected = [(480, 950)]  # 480=8*60, 950=15*60+50, 1020=17*60; clipped busy is 950-1020 so gap 950-480=470
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_ignore_entirely_outside():
    """Events partly outside the day are clipped to it."""
    result = free_slots([Event(0, 480), Event(1020, 1100)], 480, 1020)
    expected = [(480, 1020)]  # 480=8*60, 1020=17*60; both touch but share no minute so gap 1020-480=540
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_min_minutes_threshold():
    """Only gaps of at least min_minutes are returned."""
    result = free_slots([Event(30, 40), Event(70, 71)], 0, 100, min_minutes=30)
    expected = [(0, 30), (40, 70)]  # gaps 30-0=30 kept, 70-40=30 kept, 100-71=29 dropped
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_combined_unsorted_overlap_clip():
    """free_slots returns the gaps inside [day_start, day_end) not covered by any event, as (start, end) tuples sorted by start."""
    events = [Event(900, 1100), Event(700, 760), Event(400, 550), Event(540, 650)]
    result = free_slots(events, 480, 1020)
    expected = [(650, 700), (760, 900)]  # 650=10*60+50, 700=11*60+40, 760=12*60+40, 900=15*60; gaps 700-650=50, 900-760=140
    assert result == expected


def test_contract_empty_day():
    """free_slots returns the gaps inside [day_start, day_end) not covered by any event."""
    result = free_slots([], 480, 1020)
    expected = [(480, 1020)]  # 480=8*60, 1020=17*60; gap 1020-480=540
    assert result == expected


def test_contract_back_to_back_no_gap():
    """Back-to-back events (one ends exactly when the next starts) do not overlap."""
    result = free_slots([Event(540, 600), Event(600, 660)], 480, 720)
    expected = [(480, 540), (660, 720)]  # 480=8*60, 540=9*60, 660=11*60, 720=12*60; middle gap 600-600=0 excluded
    assert result == expected


def test_contract_overlaps_shared_minute():
    """Two events overlap only if they share at least one minute."""
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 610), Event(600, 660)) is True  # share 610-600=10 minutes
    assert overlaps(Event(540, 600), Event(600, 660)) is False  # 600==600 shares 0 minutes


def test_contract_parse_time():
    """parse_time turns "HH:MM" (24-hour) into minutes."""
    assert parse_time("09:30") == 570  # 9*60+30=570
    assert parse_time("00:00") == 0  # 0*60+0=0


def test_contract_fmt_duration():
    """fmt_duration renders "Xh YYm" (e.g. 65 -> "1h 05m", 45 -> "0h 45m")."""
    assert fmt_duration(65) == "1h 05m"  # 65=1*60+5
    assert fmt_duration(45) == "0h 45m"  # 45=0*60+45
